title: Quiver: Vector Database
summary: A vector database I wrote in Rust. Fast similarity search, low memory use and built-in encryption.
highlights: About 1 GB of RAM versus 31 GB for dense HNSW at 10M vectors.
Second in the reported SIFT1M comparison, behind FAISS.
Encryption, role-based access and an immutable audit log.
Python SDK, REST, gRPC, terminal UI and MCP server.
impact: 32× less RAM at equal recall in a 10M-vector benchmark. Second on SIFT1M.

title: EHR: Health Data Platform
summary: From custom health forms to research-ready data. A demo built on synthetic records.
highlights: Reviewed mappings and quality checks before export.
Trace every result back to its source.
Local OCR and versioned OMOP exports.
impact: Clear mappings. Traceable data. Repeatable exports.

title: Helio: Marketing Automation
summary: Self-hosted marketing software with an AI assistant. Build segments, run campaigns and automate customer journeys.
highlights: Separate customer workspaces with PostgreSQL row-level security.
Durable campaign workflows on Temporal.
Plain-language segments and churn prediction.
End-to-end tests and container security checks.
impact: Campaign automation your team can host.

title: Galley: LaTeX Editor
summary: A desktop LaTeX editor with live PDF preview. Your files stay local.
highlights: Isolated TeX execution and hardened archive handling.
100% Rust coverage across 14,000+ measured regions; 1,391 TypeScript tests.
CodeMirror editor, project snippets and live PDF preview.
impact: Local files, fast previews, isolated compilation.

title: Pulse: Surgical Planning
summary: A workspace for surgical knowledge, clinical scores and stent compatibility checks.
highlights: Semantic and keyword search over surgical information.
A streaming assistant built with LangGraph and Groq.
Six clinical scoring models.
Stent compatibility checks and patient PDF reports.
impact: Patient data, clinical scores and PDF reports in one place.

title: AI Resume Tailor
summary: Tailor a resume to a job description and export a clean PDF.
highlights: Resume rewriting with OpenAI and Groq.
PDF export with ReportLab.
Edit and refine the result before export.

title: Cloud Cost Assistant
summary: Analyze AWS spending, forecast costs and find savings with specialized AI agents.
highlights: Separate agents for analysis, forecasts and recommendations.
23% better dialogue coherence on internal benchmarks.
AWS Lambda, S3 and Bedrock deployment.
impact: Cloud cost analysis in minutes instead of hours.

title: Cardiac MRI Analysis
summary: A competition project combining cardiac segmentation, radiomics and classification.
highlights: U-Net, SegNet and SAM segmentation.
100+ radiomics features with PyRadiomics.
LightGBM, XGBoost and Autoencoder-SVM ensemble.
impact: First out of 100 participants. 81% validation accuracy.

title: Algal Bloom Detection
summary: Detect harmful algal blooms from Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery.
highlights: Spectral and time-based features from satellite images.
LightGBM tuning with Optuna.

title: Wearable Gait Analysis
summary: Predict knee movement from wearable sensors. Research for rehabilitation and bionic leg control.
highlights: Motion capture with Arduino Nano 33 IoT and MPU-9250.
Denoising improved signal quality by about 20%.
Compared GRU, LSTM and Transformer models.

title: Adaptive Meal Planner
summary: Recommend meals around allergies, preferences and nutrition goals.
highlights: Q-learning and genetic algorithms for meal selection.
Feedback on preferences and nutrition targets.
Structured nutritional data for 200+ meals.
impact: 200+ meals, with recommendations that learn from feedback.
